Step2 decisive ceiling argument: the fixed deterministic pipeline reproduces all 5 pairs at 33.11-37.75 dB (residual std 3.3-5.6 levels). Every grid noise function at severity 1 adds >=12.75 RMS levels of luma noise (gaussian_RGB and gaussian_YCrCb sigma_l=0.05 normalized = 12.75 levels; speckle 0.14*I ~23; poisson ~23; impulse ~13), which caps PSNR at ~29 dB or below -> NO_NOISE.
